title.en: Na's Kite and the Evening Wind

description.en: Na's new kite keeps tumbling into the grass. Sitting on the dyke with Dad, she learns to wait for the evening wind and try again.
description.vi: Cánh diều mới của Na cứ rơi xuống bãi cỏ. Ngồi trên đê cùng bố, Na học cách đợi gió chiều và thử lại lần nữa.

theme.en: When something doesn't work, rest, breathe and try again.
theme.vi: Khi chưa thành công, hãy nghỉ một chút, bình tĩnh rồi thử lại.

origin: Original StoryMoon story, written in Vietnamese with an English companion text.

characters.name: Na
characters.look: girl around five with two high pigtails, in a sunflower-yellow dress

characters.name: Dad (Bố)
characters.look: tall young father with short hair, a white short-sleeved shirt and rolled trousers

characters.name: the kite
characters.look: diamond-shaped blue paper kite with a long ribbon tail and a small bamboo flute

artDirection.mood: Open, breezy and gently hopeful, settling into a peaceful dusk.
artDirection.setting: A long grassy river dyke in the northern countryside: rice fields on one side, a wide river on the other, a water buffalo walking home, a bamboo grove.
artDirection.light: Late-afternoon gold turning into a pink and lavender sunset, then the first evening star.
motifs: a blue diamond kite with a ribbon tail
a water buffalo on the dyke

cover.prompt: a little girl and her father on a grassy dyke at sunset, a blue diamond kite soaring among pink clouds above rice fields and a river

pages.prompt: a long green dyke on a summer evening, children with kites, a little girl holding a new blue kite next to her father
sentences: On summer evenings, children flew kites on the long green dyke.
Những chiều hè, bọn trẻ thả diều trên con đê dài xanh cỏ.
Na had a new kite that she and Dad had made from bamboo and paper.
Na có một cánh diều mới, bố con Na đã cùng làm từ tre và giấy.

pages.prompt: the girl running along the dyke with the kite string, the kite wobbling and tumbling into the grass
sentences: She held the string tight and ran as fast as she could.
Na nắm chặt dây diều, chạy thật nhanh.
But the kite wobbled, flipped and landed, plop, in the grass.
Nhưng cánh diều chao đảo, lộn một vòng rồi rơi “bộp” xuống bãi cỏ.

pages.prompt: the girl sitting on the dyke with her chin in her hands, the blue kite lying in the grass beside her
sentences: Na tried again, and again it fell.
Na thử lần nữa, diều lại rơi.
“My kite doesn't want to fly,” she sighed, sitting down on the dyke.
Na ngồi phịch xuống đê, thở dài: “Diều của con không chịu bay.”

pages.prompt: father sitting beside the girl on the dyke, pointing to the sky, both listening
sentences: Dad sat beside her. “Kites need the wind, and the wind likes to take its time.”
Bố ngồi xuống bên Na: “Diều cần có gió, mà gió thì thong thả lắm con ạ.”
“Let's wait and listen for it together.”
“Mình cùng ngồi đợi và lắng nghe gió nhé.”

pages.prompt: a water buffalo walking home along the dyke, the river turning gold, rice stalks swaying, the girl's pigtails fluttering
sentences: They watched the buffalo walking home and the river turning gold.
Hai bố con ngắm chú trâu thong thả về nhà, dòng sông nhuộm ánh vàng.
Then the rice began to sway, and Na's pigtails fluttered.
Rồi những ngọn lúa bắt đầu đung đưa, tóc Na bay bay.
“Bố ơi, the wind is here!”
“Bố ơi, gió về rồi!”

pages.prompt: the blue kite soaring high among pink evening clouds, the girl letting out the string, father cheering
sentences: Na let out the string little by little, and up went the kite.
Na thả dây từ từ, từng chút một, và cánh diều vút lên cao.
Higher and higher it went, until it danced among the pink evening clouds.
Cao mãi, cao mãi, cho đến khi nó nhảy múa giữa những đám mây hồng.
Its little bamboo flute sang “vi vu, vi vu” in the wind.
Chiếc sáo tre nhỏ trên diều cất tiếng “vi vu, vi vu” trong gió.

pages.prompt: lavender dusk with the first star, father and girl winding the kite string, walking home along the dyke
sentences: When the first star appeared, Na and Dad brought the kite gently down.
Khi ngôi sao đầu tiên hiện lên, hai bố con nhẹ nhàng thu diều về.
“Good night, sky,” Na whispered. “I'll fly again tomorrow.”
Na thì thầm: “Chúc bầu trời ngủ ngon. Mai con lại bay nhé.”
And that night, she dreamed she was soaring with the kites.
Đêm ấy, Na mơ thấy mình bay lượn cùng những cánh diều.
